video_title: Jalen Williams Knew OKC Had Something Special With Jared & Ajay

quotes.speaker: Jared McCain
quotes.summary_phrase: Jared McCain's confidence during his two-way contract stint
quotes.excerpt: You know when somebody's too comfortable in a spot where you should be uncomfortable at.
quotes.quote: You know when somebody's too comfortable in a spot where you should be uncomfortable at. To come in and be second round and you're on a two-way and to come in at practice and you're going at people and if a coach were to walk in that doesn't know anything about our team, it looks like he's been there for a couple years already.

quotes.speaker: Ajay Mitchell
quotes.excerpt: I got into it as a kid, but then got more into it with that show on Netflix.
quotes.quote: I got into it as a kid, but then got more into it with that show on Netflix. And so going there is just like you feel like you're in the show. So that was pretty cool.

quotes.speaker: Jared McCain
quotes.excerpt: I was seven years old, went to take care. Drake, Kendrick opened up, I saw A$AP Rocky.
quotes.quote: I was seven years old, went to take care. Drake, Kendrick opened up, I saw A$AP Rocky. I was asleep for there. I was asleep for Kendrick and A$AP Rocky, but Drake came out and I was singing along, I was there.

quotes.speaker: Ajay Mitchell
quotes.summary_phrase: Ajay Mitchell's recruitment to Santa Clara
quotes.excerpt: One of the assistant at Santa Clara, his name is John Rillie, he started recruiting me there.
quotes.quote: One of the assistant at Santa Clara, his name is John Rillie, he started recruiting me there. And Santa Clara was the first school to recruit me, and it just just kind of happened. COVID hit when the recruitment process started, so I couldn't really visit any schools, so it was all on Zoom, but I got to see what Santa Clara was and I was like, I'm definitely going there.

quotes.speaker: Jared McCain
quotes.excerpt: I always looked up to my family friend Devin Askew and we were always tight.
quotes.quote: I always looked up to my family friend Devin Askew and we were always tight and he was a number one point guard in high school and so I always just kind of followed his his path and whatever he did. And once I moved down to Southern California, I was like, I think I think I can do this. Let me let me try like a lot harder and I just kind of fell like fell in love with that process of it.

quotes.speaker: Ajay Mitchell
quotes.summary_phrase: Ajay Mitchell's path to the NBA
quotes.excerpt: I played one year pro in Belgium, and that's when I was like, I think I can do that.
quotes.quote: I played one year pro in Belgium, and that's when I was like, I think I can do that for a living, you know. At that time I was obviously like, I want to make it to the NBA, but it's super rare to do it, especially coming out of Belgium. But I was like, that was always a goal of mine. And then I think once I got to college and got a lot more exposure, I was like, I can definitely like reach that goal.

quotes.speaker: Jalen Williams
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Williams on Jared McCain's impact
quotes.excerpt: His is different because yours happened in like the middle of the year.
quotes.quote: His is different because yours happened in like the middle of the year. So I guess I'll do Jared first because yours is more recent. Jared, I thought was going to be a good, I kind of like what everybody else is thinking like kind of like why did Philly get off him? So that that's kind of like my thought process with it. And then it's like obviously when Sam is bringing somebody in middle of the year, which doesn't happen often, he obviously sees kind of like the same thing. So that usually gives you a lot of confidence.

quotes.speaker: Jalen Williams
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Williams on Ajay Mitchell's draft process
quotes.excerpt: I think when Sam had even brought up Ajay for the draft, I'd kind of already seen.
quotes.quote: I think when Sam had even brought up Ajay for the draft, I'd kind of already seen a little bit, but you know how like they have like the, what's that, what's that YouTube that posts like Draft Express? Yeah, but no, no, it's like low key. It's not, it's not a, it's not a, you don't know, because you don't get posted on this one. It's like, they really only post like mid-major stuff. But I had seen it on there and I was like, okay, he's like, you can, you can tell when somebody can like really play. So when he got to our team and we did, like our week of runs before preseason training and stuff, I was like, yeah, he's legit. He can play. And everybody in the gym kind of knew it.

quotes.speaker: Ajay Mitchell
quotes.summary_phrase: Ajay Mitchell on his draft night experience
quotes.excerpt: I didn't know what was going to happen at all, so the first round I was like.
quotes.quote: I didn't know what was going to happen at all, so the first round I was like, let's just do a dinner somewhere, put the TV on and see what happens. My agents were like, there's a chance you get picked like late first, and I remember Milwaukee had like the 23rd pick or something, and I went there, they really like me, my sister lived in Wisconsin, so I was like, can see that connection. And so my whole family was like, this might be like, you might be in Milwaukee, and that would be great. And then so the 23rd pick comes up and they're like, with the 23rd pick, Milwaukee selects Ajay, and then everyone in the room is like, oh my gosh, what's going on? And then they say Johnson and it gets so awkward. Like I'm trying to be like, oh, it's all good, but in my head I'm like, what? Like, no way. So it was awkward.

quotes.speaker: Ajay Mitchell
quotes.summary_phrase: Ajay Mitchell's defensive development in the NBA
quotes.excerpt: I was never really known for my defense, and once I got to OKC, I knew that.
quotes.quote: I was never really known for my defense, and once I got to OKC, I knew that was like a big part of what they do. And so for me it was like, okay, like I got a lot of good examples to learn from like AC, him, Cason, Lou. And so just learning from those guys and how they do it, and then now I feel like when I'm out there like I just got to go out there and play like with a good defense.
